meta.name: baoyu-post-to-x
meta.description: Posts content and articles to X (Twitter). Supports regular posts with images/videos and X Articles (long-form Markdown). In Codex, honor explicit requests for the Codex Chrome plugin/@chrome by using the Chrome Extension workflow; otherwise use Chrome Computer Use when available and fall back to real Chrome CDP scripts only when allowed. Use when user asks to "post to X", "tweet", "publish to Twitter", or "share on X".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动将内容发布到 X 平台
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要定时或即时将文章推送到 X 账号。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically post content to X platform
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to schedule or instantly push articles to your X account.

howto.what: 它能让 Claude 用你已登录的真实 Chrome,把文字、图片、视频发到 X(推特),也能把 Markdown 长文发成 X Article;点发布前会先向你确认。
howto.when: 当你要求把内容发到 X,例如提到「post to X」「tweet」等说法时接管;未指定发布类型时,纯文本走普通帖,Markdown 文件走 X Article。

say.note: 走普通帖流程,填好内容等你确认发布

say.text: 把这篇 article.md 发成 X Article

howto.what_en: It lets Claude post text, images, and videos to X (Twitter) through your real logged-in Chrome, and publish long-form Markdown as X Articles. It asks for your confirmation before clicking Publish or Post.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to post to X, e.g. "post to X" or "tweet". If no post type is given, plain text goes to a regular post and a .md file goes to an X Article.

say_en.text: Post to X: the weather is nice today
say_en.note: Regular post flow; it fills the composer and waits for confirmation

say_en.text: Publish article.md as an X Article
say_en.note: Converts the Markdown and inserts images in the draft
